subject: Usage tier & minimum spend — flex credits and overage options
messages:
From: Sasha Nguyen <sasha.nguyen@stratoscommerce.com>
To: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 13:02:00 -0000
Subject: Clarify minimums / burst handling for hosted API

Hi Diego,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency profile looked good for our recommendations engine. Before we surface to procurement, two quick questions about the Hosted API pricing model you shared:

- What is the minimum monthly spend (if any) to get committed-tier pricing?
- If we go committed but exceed the monthly allocation for a short period (spikes during promos), how do you treat overages vs. burst capacity? Are burst tokens billed at on-demand rates, or is there a separate burst bucket/discount?
- Can you do a short-term flexibility credit (so unused commit can be converted) or a true‑up cadence shorter than quarterly?

We have legal looking at SLAs and they may ask for an explicit overage cap or soft throttling. Happy to jump on a call if that helps.

—Sasha
Head of Platform Partnerships
StratosCommerce

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sasha Nguyen <sasha.nguyen@stratoscommerce.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 09:18:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Clarify minimums / burst handling for hosted API

Sasha — great to hear. Quick answers up front and an attachment with a concrete proposal attached.

Summary (short):
- Minimum / commit: We offer month-to-month commit tiers; the entry committed tier for enterprise pricing is 25M tokens/month. Volume discounts scale at 50M and 150M.
- Overage / burst: Two mechanisms: 1) automatic burst: short spikes are serviced at on-demand rates (no immediate throttle) and true‑up monthly; 2) optional purchased burst bucket: a pre-paid buffer (e.g., 20% of commit) billed at a discounted overage rate.
- Flex credits / true-up: We can do monthly true-ups for the first 6 months of the contract and convert up to 10% of unused commit into flex credits that can be consumed as burst in the following 60 days.

Attached: RWI-Proposal-Jan2026.pdf (summary table + sample price points) and usage-schedule.xlsx (monthly profile template).

If this looks reasonable I can put together a narrow offer: 15% introductory discount on the first 6 months of committed tier pricing + a 20% discounted burst bucket (pre-paid) and monthly true-ups. Legal/finance will need to sign off on a lower overage rate if Stratos wants a capped overage.

Proposed next step: 30-minute call next week to agree on committed tier size and whether you want a pre-paid burst bucket or purely on-demand overage.

Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0198

Looping you in — forwarding Sasha's note and my reply. Key asks from Stratos: minimum commit size clarity, prefer a predictable burst treatment (either discounted pre-paid bucket or capped overage rate), and faster true-up cadence.

Ask: can we offer the following as a negotiable commercial play?
- Entry committed tier: 25M tokens / month at $0.00065/token (list), with a 15% introductory credit for 6 months (effective $0.0005525/token).
- On-demand overage: $0.00110/token (retail).
- Discounted burst bucket (pre-paid): up to 20% of commit billed at $0.00085/token. Bucket can be used within 30 days, unused portions expire.
- Monthly true-up for first 6 months, after which we revert to quarterly true-up unless they opt otherwise.

Finance/legal: will we accept $0.00085 for burst bucket as an approved overage discount for this mid‑market ARR? Also wondering if we can let them convert 10% unused commit to flex credits for next month.

Please advise; I have a call with Sasha + Liam next Wednesday and want to lock a solid offer by Monday EOD.

—Diego

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: diego_fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.inference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sat, 17 Jan 2026 11:30:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Fwd: Clarify minimums / burst handling for hosted API

Diego — thanks for the summary. My read: this is a good mid-market play; Stratos is sensitive to promo spikes, so flexibility on bursts will close faster. My recommendations:

- Accept the 25M entry tier pricing but move the list price to $0.0006/token (rounding helps the math) and keep your 15% intro credit for 6 months.
- Set on-demand overage at $0.00105/token (we should keep a healthy delta vs. committed rate).
- Approve discounted pre-paid burst bucket at $0.00080/token for up to 20% of commit (this will be treated as a separate line item with 30‑day consumption window). Finance should treat this as non-refundable but convertible to credits if they expand commit within 90 days.
- Approve monthly true-up for the first 6 months. After that, default to quarterly.

Also recommend a short clause in commercial terms: if cumulative overages exceed 40% of commit for two consecutive months, we trigger a commercial review (can be used to propose an uplifted commit). Helps protect margins.

If legal pushes back on converting unused commit to credits, we can instead offer a one-time sizing credit equal to 10% of first month commit.

Happy to join the Wed call. I can bring a short slide showing dollars saved by using pre-paid burst vs on-demand.

—Ben
